label: Fires at D1 after an unrewarded a1->S1 trial, stronger when belief favours S1 and later in episode.
short_terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * ep_dec
terms: (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * belief_lo ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * ep_dec ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * (tv("action", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") * belief_cover ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == -1)
explanation: Silent at GO and D2. At D1 it is essentially a detector of the previous trial being a1 -> S1 common and unrewarded (residual +0.25 vs about -0.03 for every other pattern); this single indicator gives dev R2 0.28 beyond timing. Its magnitude within that case grows with the ideal observer belief that S1 is good (belief_lo, positive weight) and with episode time (ep_dec), raising dev R2 to 0.345. The free fit (trial-before reward/action, belief_cover, a1 S1 r, unknown-previous-trial) adds only 0.01 (0.354). The largest remaining misses are D1 steps on the first trial of a window, where the previous trial is not in the window and cannot be scored; the all-cue ceiling is 0.37, so the short form is near the additive ceiling but below the 0.4 threshold.
